mapper.select: SELECT d.drill_id drillId,d.backup_id backupId,d.ended_at endedAt, d.rpo_seconds rpoSeconds,d.rto_seconds rtoSeconds,d.evidence_sha256 evidenceSha256 FROM bak_restore_drill d JOIN bak_backup_set b ON b.backup_id=d.backup_id WHERE d.state='PASS' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tenantId},b.tenant_ids_csv)>0 ORDER BY d.ended_at DESC,d.drill_id DESC LIMIT 1
